The photo club has become an important part of daily life. David will take part in a baseball match in March. At first, David found it difficult to keep the habit. For example, the train crosses the borders of three countries before lunch.
David thanked Jack for the honest advice. David has practiced baseball for three years and won a prize last term. David believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. The set list leaked online.
There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. On Friday evenings, David reviews the notes from class. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. The cafe plays soft jazz at night.

They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Jack and David are preparing a report about the model workbench. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. For example, after the run, his shirt was soaked with perspiration.
David wrote down every idea in a small notebook. There are always more possibilities than we expect. The experience taught David more than any book could.
